subject.title: fix(ui): add timeout to control-ui bootstrap config fetch

question: May the Control UI intentionally abandon server-provided bootstrap config after 15 seconds and continue with defaults when a reverse proxy or gateway is slow but would eventually respond?
rationale: The patch fixes an indefinite wait but changes successful slow-start behavior on an authentication- and routing-sensitive bootstrap path, so the permanent deadline and fallback semantics require UI-owner intent.

options.title: Approve 15 seconds with browser proof
options.body: Retain the deadline after real-browser evidence demonstrates stalled fallback and acceptable slow-response behavior for supported deployments.

options.title: Revise the deadline strategy
options.body: Use an owner-approved longer or differently scoped deadline while preserving bounded startup and add equivalent browser-path proof.

options.title: Pause the behavior change
options.body: Keep the PR open without merging until deployment latency expectations and bootstrap metadata requirements are better established.

recommendation.title: Approve 15 seconds with browser proof
recommendation.body: Retain the deadline after real-browser evidence demonstrates stalled fallback and acceptable slow-response behavior for supported deployments.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history directly connects server bootstrap metadata to Control UI connection behavior.
